== Overview ==

Enter Midhem Online, a free-to-play Tibia-inspired MMORPG with custom progression, quests, PvP, and two distinct EU worlds: seasonal Tempra and permanent Perma. This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.

Players searching for '''Midhem''' usually want the official website, client download path, rules, rates, and whether the world is still active. See:
